children: According to Wallstreetcn, South Korea's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol abruptly canceled his trip to the United States to attend the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting, and all bilateral talks with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and other major officials were also canceled.

title: South Korea's Deputy Prime Minister Cancels Trip to U.S. for G20 Finance Meeting
